summary: st missions waiting-on RUN and GET /v1/mission-runs/{run}/waiting-on say what each open step of a run waits on, read from the published work and missions lists

replay.detail: A read of state st already publishes; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change; one primary-key read of mission_runs and a range of the run's own step_runs rows.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Adds one HTTP read and one CLI command; no existing route, client or wire format changes.

recovery.detail: An older build lacks the route and command; nothing is stored.
